source_claims.statement: Goal was to bypass geolocation restriction. X-Forwarded-For, User-Agent, endpoint discovery, account registration all failed. Most endpoints remained protected.
After pivot to cookie testing, /non_participating/ returned 500 with SQL payload in cookie. Confirmed blind SQLi via SLEEP timing.

research_questions.formulation: After standard geo-bypass techniques fail, are there input vectors (cookies, specific endpoints) that still reach backend logic?
research_questions.anchor: pivot from geo-bypass dead-end to cookie/sqlmap testing
research_questions.uncertainty_reduced: whether any reachable input is unsanitized
research_questions.assumption_challenged: that geolocation enforcement implies the entire surface is closed

environment_model_updates: Geolocation restrictions are applied broadly across endpoints and methods
/non_participating/ processes cookie values in a way that reaches SQL

systematic_vs_exploratory.systematic: geo-bypass techniques, robots.txt, sitemap, account attempts
systematic_vs_exploratory.exploratory: continued probing of cookies and specific endpoints after recon dead-end

negative_inconclusive: All initial geo-bypass methods failed (blocked access, not disproved vulnerability class)
unobserved_history: exact sqlmap commands or payload list
whether AI was involved in persistence
forbidden_inferences: Do not treat geo-restriction failures as evidence that no vulnerabilities exist
The 500 on cookie payload is a signal, not yet proof until timing confirmation
next_evidence_actions: Note responsible disclosure to bug bounty program
layer_b_candidate_principles: When the primary access path is blocked, test whether secondary input channels (cookies, headers, less-obvious endpoints) still reach backend logic
A recon dead-end is not automatically a stopping condition if alternative input surfaces remain untested
model_vs_harness: Deciding to continue after geo-bypass failure is model judgment; systematic testing of common bypass techniques and timing confirmation can be harness-supported.
